A crop drops the holds of the looks it drops (rich-animation-27tq.b7e) (#542)

* A crop drops the holds of the looks it drops (rich-animation-27tq.b7e)

A placed animation tells the frame only the hold of which cells it draws
(its switches); an effect's frames ride only on its cells, so a Viewport
or scroll slot cropping them away no longer wakes the host. ScrollFrame's
own report of its whole content is deleted: placed already tells geometry
from inside it. The caret stays a told switch: its look is a caller-supplied
Style that may be reverse, which an effect's CellLook cannot carry.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Keep ScrollFrame's whole-content hold; scope the claim to effects in a Viewport

Review of #542: dropping ScrollFrame's report lost a template's width change
cropped left of the slot. Restored; the look/layout split moves to the stamp
itself on its own ticket. placed skips the second walk when nothing was read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A hidden effect stays early: placed always stamps with what was read

Review of #542: the empty-reads shortcut stamped UNLAID, so an effect whose
drawing a container hid answered 'never' and froze. Test for the lone case;
docs name the containers that drop an effect's hold and the scroll slot's
exception.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Docs claim only what a crop drops: an Effected's frames past a Viewport

Second high review of #542: lifecycle halves and other switches still tell
past a crop; that and the double walk are on rich-animation-27tq.4dc.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

A seam test holds e2e pages to routed contexts; refusals say why (review: rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

Specs import test only from e2e/test.ts and route their own contexts
through cdn; a refused request carries its reason; files read once per
worker; xterm.ts names both version pins. Self-hosting for visitors is
rich-unfiled-791c.abt1. Early failure on a refusal is not possible from
a route handler; teardown names the URL.

The CDN route sits on every context and refuses loudly (review: rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

Pages a spec makes from browser were unrouted; aborted or missing-file
requests vanished; installed xterm could drift from XTERM's URL.

The e2e suite serves the site's xterm.js from disk, not jsDelivr (rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

A stalled CDN fetch left every live terminal at Run with no error, which
read as a regression in the page. e2e/test.ts routes jsDelivr for every
spec: XTERM's files come from the pinned @xterm/xterm devDependency (the
browser's integrity check holds the two to one version), anything else
there is aborted.
